AgentSession execution and context maintenance [agent-session.ts]
|
|-- prompt() / _preparePrompt()
|   |-- prompt(): extension command may handle input without starting a run
|   |-- Input hooks -> skill/template expansion -> model/auth validation if idle
|   `-- While streaming: explicit steer/followUp behavior required, else error
|-- _startRun() / _prepareRun()
|   |-- Check compaction; emit before_agent_start; normalize images
|   |-- Prompt options + tool loadout -> starting messages and system patch
|   `-- -> Agent.prompt(messages)
|-- Agent.prompt() / continue() -> agent-loop.ts runLoop()
|   |-- prepareRequest(): AgentSession-installed request projection
|   |   |-- -> SessionManager.buildSessionProjection(): canonical messages
|   |   |-- context.tools retains executable Agent tools
|   |   `-- -> ModelRuntime.resolveModel(): virtual routing; retain user selection
|   |-- streamAssistantResponse()
|   |   |-- transformContext() -> extension context hook -> convertToLlm()
|   |   `-- Agent streamFn -> ModelRuntime.streamSimple() -> provider response
|   |-- executeToolCalls()
|   |   |-- Lookup context.tools; prepare arguments; validateToolArguments()
|   |   |-- beforeToolCall -> tool.execute(signal, onUpdate) -> afterToolCall
|   |   `-- Tool results -> transcript; results/steering can trigger another turn
|   |-- Follow-ups drain when the loop would otherwise stop
|   `-- Events -> AgentSession._handleAgentEvent(); agent_end ends this loop
|-- _handlePostAgentRun() and pre-settlement boundary
|   |-- Retryable error -> _prepareRetry() -> Agent.continue()
|   |-- Overflow/threshold compaction recovery -> possible Agent.continue()
|   `-- Boundary continuation and queues settle -> agent_settled, beyond agent_end
|-- compact() / _checkCompaction() / _runAutoCompaction()
|   |-- Branch history + model limits + settings -> prepareCompaction()
|   |-- Extension can cancel or supply summary; otherwise default summarization
|   `-- -> appendCompaction(); refresh projected Agent context, preserve history
|-- navigateTree()
|   `-- -> SessionManager.branch() or branchWithSummary(); refresh context
`-- abort()
    `-- Cancel Agent/recovery work and await waitForIdle()
